create_PAIREDRunner: create a PAIREDRunner instance with student and teacher agents for paired RL training
run_PAIREDRunner_step: run one PAIREDRunner training update step that rolls out teacher and students then updates both with PPO
reset_PAIREDRunner: reset the PAIREDRunner state and reinitialize student and teacher agent populations with fresh RNG
compile_PAIREDRunner_stats: compile and aggregate training metrics for student and teacher agents including mean returns and episode stats
checkpoint_PAIREDRunner: save or load a PAIREDRunner checkpoint state for student and teacher training states
